blockheads.title: Blockheads: Online Multiplayer Block Shooter
blockheads.slogan: Jump into the action-packed world of Blockheads!
blockheads.description: Blockheads is a block-based first-person shooter where you can battle with other online players! Engage in intense gunfights, take down opponents, and compete for the ultimate weapon. Use the in-game upgrade system to boost your health, speed, recovery, and more to gain an edge over your rivals. Dive into this life-or-death battle and see if you can rise to the top!
